data_governance.access_review_process: Accessing the dataset requires logging in through a verified ID system, agreeing to use the data only for type 2 diabetes related research, and agreeing to the license terms, which set certain restrictions and obligations for data usage. FAIRhub records the access type as "PublicDownloadSelfAttestationRequired" and publishes the conditions of access at https://fairhub.io/datasets/3/access.
stewardship_roles: The data manager at each data site is responsible for the quality control of all data before uploading to FAIRhub; the AI-READI team supports and maintains the dataset, which is hosted on FAIRhub through Microsoft Azure. The RO-Crate names the AI-READI Consortium as the data governance committee.
data_governance.notes: The BMJ Open protocol publication states that the requirements for the controlled access dataset were being developed by a Data Access Committee, and that procedures for reviewing and prioritizing written requests for biorepository samples would be developed before the biorepository is complete.

external_resources.name: AI-READI dataset documentation
external_resources.description: Documentation for version 3.0.0 of the dataset at https://docs.aireadi.org, covering citation, preliminary information on access and training prerequisites, per-domain dataset documentation including the Healthsheet, controlled variables, AI-readiness and additional resources. The healthsheet states that the dataset is self-contained but does rely on this documentation for users requiring additional information about the provenance of the dataset.
restrictions: None; the documentation is shared under the CC-BY 4.0 license, so there are no restrictions associated with its use.
